description: Defines the AlwaysSelectedCollectionView class implementing ICollectionView for managing collection selection with a fixed current item, and its converter class for XAML binding.

classes.name: AlwaysSelectedCollectionView
classes.description: A collection view that maintains a fixed current item, with limited implementation of ICollectionView.

classes.name: AlwaysSelectedCollectionViewConverter
classes.description: A value converter for creating AlwaysSelectedCollectionView instances from IList for XAML binding.

methods.name: MoveCurrentTo
methods.description: Moves the current position to the specified item if it exists in the source collection.

methods.name: MoveCurrentToPosition
methods.description: Moves the current position to the specified index within the collection.

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Converts an IList to an AlwaysSelectedCollectionView for data binding.

methods.name: ConvertBack
methods.description: Returns UnsetValue as conversion back is not supported.
